Eli (infra): GigaSupply just messaged — two H100 units we had reserved were rolled back to a satellite forwarder during booking. They say a manifest mismatch triggered the rollback.
Maya (procurement): Ugh. Which AWBs and when did that happen?
GigaSupply-Rep: Sorry team — confirmed: AWB 770-XS1 and 770-XS2 were reallocated by our SAT-FWD partner at 03:14 local. It was an automated failover when the original airway bill was flagged for missing customs docs.
Julian (ops): That kills our US-central topoff this week if we lose both. Any chance of getting holdback or swap?
GigaSupply-Rep: We can requeue but the earliest rebook window is +6 business days unless we cover the expedite surcharge (air bridge uplift).
Maya (procurement): How much is uplift? Need numbers to approve.
GigaSupply-Rep: Estimate: +18% freight + $4000 air-refile fee. If we provide corrected HS codes and proof of payment today we can try a same-day reattach but no guarantees.
procurement-bot: Allocation update: SKU H100-48 — 2 units rolled back -> status: PENDING_REBOOK.
Lia (logistics): If they requeue with SAT-FWD we need POD and serial mapping upfront. Last time SAT-FWD sent partial serial list and it didn't match our manifest which caused the flag.
Ken (support): Can we use our reserve credits or a temporary loaner from LocalPool? What's the current LocalPool availability?
Eli (infra): LocalPool has 1x H100 reserved for latency-critical, not available without violating pledge. We might compromise if we can bring 2x H100 equivalent via aggregated A800+quant mix, but that needs infra sign-off.
Julian (ops): We cannot degrade SLAs. If GigaSupply cant confirm reattach, escalate to expediting vendor or hit the emergency supplier list.
Maya (procurement): I'll ask legal to approve the expedite surcharge if there's no cheaper route. Also ask GigaSupply for the exact manifest diff so we can patch the docs.
GigaSupply-Rep: Copy — attaching manifest diff and the SAT-FWD note.
GigaSupply-Rep: ```manifest_diff.txt
- AWB770-XS1: missing HS code 8471.80 -> flagged
- AWB770-XS2: serial list truncated (only 6/8 serials)
```
Maya (procurement): Great, sending corrected HS code for both now. Also attaching purchase invoices to the broker email thread.
Maya (procurement): @Julian @Eli if we can push the broker proof now, can you prepare a recover flow if they accept (RMA vs reattach)? Need steps: (1) accept reattach -> apply customs hold release, (2) accept loaner -> schedule handover, (3) fallback -> request overnight A800 loaners.
Julian (ops): I'll draft the flow. Key ops notes: verify serials on dock, photo evidence, and immediate tagging to our provisioning pool. If reattach occurs, request courier hold for 24h to validate serials before final handoff.
Ken (support): Add an alert to infra to avoid automated deployments to the impacted pool until serials are reconciled. Last time we accidentally started jobs on partial hardware.
Eli (infra): Will add a temporary guardrail: disable autoscale for pool-redwood-usc-3 and add routing policy to fall back to regional edge (us-west) for writes only.
procurement-bot: Ticket created: PROC-8147 (expedite-surcharge-approval).
Maya (procurement): GigaSupply — please push SAT-FWD manifest and broker contact. If they accept our docs we will cover the surcharge. If they insist on the satellite forwarder pickup, we need photo evidence & scanned serials before they depart.
GigaSupply-Rep: Understood. Pinging SAT-FWD and broker now. ETA on reply ~45m.
Julian (ops): In parallel we should spool a mitigation test: run a canary across us-west with reduced batch size and capture latency/throughput delta. If we see >15% regression, need exec signoff to pay expedite.
Eli (infra): Canary scheduled. I'll post results in this thread when done.
Maya (procurement): Thanks. Also, add note: if SAT-FWD returns units with any physical damage we require depot RMA and photos + serial reconciliation prior to acceptance. No exceptions.
GigaSupply-Rep: Acknowledged — will instruct forwarder.
Ken (support): FYI forwarding this to SOC for customs docs trace: soc-ops@redwood.corp.
Lia (logistics): If reattach fails and we need split-air, we will ask for part-air part-sea mix to reduce cost. That adds complexity for thermal packaging, flagging to depot.
Maya (procurement): Copy. I'll set threshold: if total expedite > $12k, revert to split-air/sea plan and request quoted lead-times.
Julian (ops): One more ask — if the rebook happens, can we demand serial manifest before transfer of custody? Add it as a condition to the POD.
GigaSupply-Rep: Yes, we will set a pre-transfer checklist.
Eli (infra): Canary done: 5% median latency increase, 1.2x p95 tokens usage. Not catastrophic but could push some tail-sensitive workflows.
Julian (ops): Put that into the cost/benefit. Maya, up to you — we need decision before broker reply.
Maya (procurement): Approve expedite up to $10k immediate. If broker asks more, escalate to finance. Proceed with proofs and insist on pre-transfer serial manifest and photos.
GigaSupply-Rep: Proceeding with reattach attempt. Will update in ~45m.
Maya (procurement): Thanks everyone. Post any shipping docs here as soon as they come in. :thumbsup:
